title: niobe bench --json
description: A suite of tasks — or, with --ab, the suite twice, without a technique and with it — each run as one niobe -p turn in a copy of its files and judged by its check. Every figure is one a turn's own report gave; none is an estimate. A field is added without moving schema_version; it moves when one changes meaning or goes away.

started_at.description: When the first task started, RFC 3339 in UTC to the second.

timeout_seconds.description: How long each turn was let run before it was ended.

tasks.description: Each task, in the order of their names.

ab.description: niobe bench --ab: the suite run without the technique, then with it.

technique.description: The technique measured: off in the first run, on in the second.

change.description: How far each figure moved from the first run to the second, as a fraction of the first run's: -0.1 is a tenth less. Null where either run left the figure unreported or the first run's was zero.

passed.description: Tasks passed with the technique, less those passed without it.

without.description: The suite run with the technique off.

with.description: The suite run with the technique on.

passed.description: Whether the task's check exited 0 in the repository the turn left. A turn that timed out is not checked and has not passed.

outcome.description: How the turn ended: the -p outcome where it reported one, timed_out where it ran past the deadline, unreported where niobe ended without a report.

reason.description: Why the turn did not finish, or null where it did.

wall_ms.description: How long the turn took by the bench's clock, laying out the files included and the check not.

kept.description: Where the copy the turn worked in was kept, for a task that did not pass; null where it passed and the copy was removed.

turn.description: The turn's own report, as niobe -p --json printed it, or null where it printed none.

pass_rate.description: passed over tasks, from 0 to 1; null for a suite of no tasks.

tokens.description: Every token the turns spent, or null where a turn reported no spend, since a sum short of one turn would read as the suite's.

tokens_reported_by.description: How many turns reported their spend.

output_tokens.description: The tokens the turns' models wrote, summed, where every turn reported them; null otherwise.

five_hour.description: Where the five-hour window stood after the first turn that reported it and after the last; null where none did. The window is the account's: anything else it ran moved it too.
